title: Python Database Tutorial - GeeksforGeeks
content:
Python provides support for working with different databases, allowing us to connect to databases, run queries, and manage data using Python.

  • Relational Databases store data in tables with rows and columns, such as MySQL and SQLite.
  • Non-Relational Databases store data in flexible formats such as documents and key-value pairs, such as MongoDB.
  • Connect to databases, run queries, and manage data using Python.
  • Work with JSON data for storing and exchanging structured information.

MySQL

It connects Python applications with MySQL databases. It converts data between Python and MySQL types and does not require third-party libraries.

Note: For more information, refer to our detailed Python MySQL Tutorial

MongoDB

Popular NoSQL database that stores data in a flexible document-based format instead of tables. It uses BSON, a binary format similar to JSON, for storing and retrieving data.
